scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:example
scripts.build:example: pnpm run build:example:module-federation && pnpm run build:example:native-import && pnpm run build:example:file-routing
scripts.dev:examples: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names invoices,orders,host,native,file-routing,file-virtual --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green,blue,yellow,red "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-invoices dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-remote dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-host dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-host dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual dev"
scripts.dev:example:module-federation: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names invoices,orders,host --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-invoices dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-remote dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-host dev"
scripts.dev:example:native-import: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build:incremental && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-host dev
scripts.dev:example:file-routing: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build:incremental && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names physical,virtual --prefix-colors yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing dev" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual dev"
scripts.dev:example:file-routing:physical: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build:incremental && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing dev
scripts.dev:example:file-routing:virtual: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-remote build:incremental && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual dev
scripts.preview:examples: pnpm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names invoices,orders,host,native,file-routing,file-virtual --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green,blue,yellow,red "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-invoices preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-remote preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-host preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-host preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual preview"
scripts.preview:example:module-federation: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:example:module-federation && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names invoices,orders,host --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-invoices preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-remote preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-host preview"
scripts.preview:example:native-import: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:example:native-import && pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-native-import-host preview
scripts.preview:example:file-routing: pnpm run build:example:file-routing && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names physical,virtual --prefix-colors yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing preview" "pnpm --filter @tanstack-router-remote/example-file-routing-virtual preview"
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.changeset:version: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only && pnpm run format
